column1: # Proof classes: the one declaration of the class names, their rank, and the stateful words BOTH classifiers share.
# Readers: lib/gate/proof-classes.sh, sourced by proof-ledger.sh `classify` (reads the branch DIFF, ship time) and
# proof-gate.sh `class` (reads the TASK TEXT, plan time). tests/test-proof-class-table.sh fails when either types these again.
# Columns are TAB-separated: kind, value, arg.
#   class     value = class name; arg = rank (unique integers, low = lighter proof owed: inert < behavioral < stateful)
#   stateful  value = an ERE that marks work as stateful in BOTH classifiers; arg = a sample task text it matches (the test feeds it to each)
# Only words both classifiers already shared live here. Each classifier keeps its own input rules and its own extra words
# (the ledger: /db/ and \bseed\b; the gate: release to, ship to prod, \bdb\b, backfill data, seed, stateful, drops, delete data, incident, triage).
